name: Dawnsire
description: The Dawnsire is the Sunstar Free Company's javelin-shaped dreadnought, built around a horizon javelin meant to reignite the Sotheran supervoid as a star.

summary.text: The Dawnsire is the Sunstar Free Company's javelin-shaped dreadnought, built around a horizon javelin meant to reignite the Sotheran supervoid as a star.

bio.text: The Dawnsire is shielded and escorted by the Candela and is captained by Slats.
Raphaella's final transmission described the Dawnsire, and the Monoist inevitors then launched toward it.
Vondam and Haliya went to its bridge and met Captain Slats, who ordered collision alarms and the deployment of knights as impact approached.
An inevitor struck the Dawnsire and deployed a cherazad that suspended most of the impact, and Nacha fired a laser pulse train across two hundred lightseconds.
Vondam and Haliya later left the Dawnsire in a secret rush, telling no one, not even Slats.
Sami learned the ship carries a weapon to turn Sothera back into a sun.

status.text: As of the latest mention, the Dawnsire is described as the vessel that will reignite the supervoid, with Vondam commanding a knightly host assigned to defend it.

timeline.summary: Raphaella's final transmission explains the Monoist purpose, describes the Dawnsire and Candela, and bids farewell as her inevitor falls toward Sothera.
timeline.quote: that we will destroy the Dawnsire

timeline.summary: The Monoist inevitors launch toward the Dawnsire, and Alpharael learns they will hit at thirty kilometers a second.
timeline.quote: We hit it at thirty kilometers a second.

timeline.summary: Vondam and Haliya go to the Dawnsire's bridge and meet Captain Slats, an Astelli, who phorocasts that Vondam will die in the battle.
timeline.quote: I phorocast that you die in the battle.

timeline.summary: Haliya blurts that the prophecy might be an enemy trick, uttering the blasphemy anstruth.
timeline.quote: "Anstruth, Syr," she says.

timeline.summary: The bridge darkens red as phorocast detects an imminent impact, and Slats orders collision alarms and the deployment of knights.
timeline.quote: Garrison to repel boarders, number-two basilica!

timeline.summary: Vondam closes his helmet and tells Haliya to look to the Sum, then goes to face the attack.
timeline.quote: Look to the Sum, Squire.

timeline.summary: The inevitor strikes the Dawnsire and deploys a cherazad that suspends most of the impact.
timeline.quote: As it strikes the Dawnsire , the inevitor deploys a cyst of altered space, a tactical event horizon: a cherazad.

timeline.summary: Anti-armor mines hit Zagachoir and ricochet inside his armor and body.
timeline.quote: Every cnidomine in the compartment hits Zagachoir.

timeline.summary: The boarding party leaps for the inner hull toward the Sunstar defenders.
timeline.quote: Everyone casts their center of mass forward.

timeline.summary: Zagachoir, spinning and bleeding, asks Alpharael to help him take sekhar.
timeline.quote: "I want to take sekhar now."

timeline.summary: Alpharael crushes Zagachoir's singularity bead housing, sending him into the Next Eternity.
timeline.quote: Alpharael crushes the singularity bead's housing and kicks free.

timeline.summary: Zagachoir collapses into a violet pinprick that falls out through the hull.
timeline.quote: Zagachoir collapses into a violet pinprick, eaten by the uncaged void.

timeline.summary: A Sunstar foot soldier blinds Nagashua with a bladiator flash and kills her.
timeline.quote: He thrusts the bladiator through her heart.

timeline.summary: The Monoist boarders overwhelm the Sunstar defenders in a short fight.
timeline.quote: Then, it is over. Alpharael barely got to swing his axe.

timeline.summary: A puzzler takes sekhar and the resulting microvoid pierces the inner hull, letting the boarders open a hatch.
timeline.quote: One of the puzzlers bellows, "Praise HIM !" and takes sekhar.

timeline.summary: Behind the hatch the boarders find a Sunstar basilica and someone begins burning it.
timeline.quote: It's a basilica, a house of the Sunstar faith.

timeline.summary: Purael orders the mission to continue, with the puzzle club going downship to find the blasphemy mechanisms.
timeline.quote: Puzzle club downship.

timeline.summary: Alpharael volunteers to go with Simma to kill a Solar Knight and is shot.
timeline.quote: "I'm coming with you!" Alpharael says.

timeline.summary: Squire Haliya follows Syr Vondam down the Dawnsire's spine, convinced she will die.
timeline.quote: They plunge down the Dawnsire 's spine.

timeline.summary: Haliya fears for Vondam, who is prophesied to die, and resolves to die before him.
timeline.quote: Vondam is prophesied to die.

timeline.summary: Vondam, Walker and Quinidad learn from a phonon survey that Sunstar garrison troops are fighting the boarders near the basilica.
timeline.quote: A company of the garrison has engaged boarders just abeam of the basilica.

timeline.summary: Vondam and Walker fire their bladiators through the deck to strike the Monoists below, with Haliya cleaning Vondam's beamline.
timeline.quote: The two knights plunge their bladiators into the deck and fire .

timeline.summary: The Monoists below pulse gravity waves at the deck, shaking it apart.
timeline.quote: The deck whines under their boots.

timeline.summary: The deck collapses under Haliya.
timeline.quote: The deck goes out from under her.

timeline.summary: As she falls, Haliya broadcasts all her power to protect Vondam.
timeline.quote: She throws her arms out to her knight and broadcasts every bit of power she can.

timeline.summary: Haliya blasts her way out of a flooded bathhouse tank with a bladiator steam jet.
timeline.quote: The steam jet cuts through the soft wall of the water tank, and the boiling water blasts her out like a cork into the bathhouse floor.

timeline.summary: Haliya fires at a Monoist fanatic gliding toward her.
timeline.quote: Haliya snaps her bladiator up and fires.

timeline.summary: Beams cut through the ceiling at Alpharael, but a thrown jar of aeromuck saves him from being killed.
timeline.quote: Two beams through the ceiling skewer Alpharael.

timeline.summary: Simma pulls on space and drops a collapsing structure on the enemy, buying minutes.
timeline.quote: Far above her, something rumbles and comes down like an avalanche.

timeline.summary: Alpharael bellows a challenge to the Sunstar defenders as bait for Simma's plan.
timeline.quote: I am Alpharael of Secundi, and against me, your armor is—cracked leather!

timeline.summary: In the bathhouse Alpharael is shot by a seemingly dead Summist, who is Haliya.
timeline.quote: The dead Summist shoots him.

timeline.summary: Alpharael's tidal attack backfires and hits his own armor.
timeline.quote: He has shot himself in the face.

timeline.summary: A Monoist fanatic seizes Haliya's helmet and concusses her at ninety-five gravities.
timeline.quote: The concussion blanks her.

timeline.summary: Alpharael, thinking of his lost sister, pins Haliya and attacks her head.
timeline.quote: So Alpharael bears down on the fallen Summist and rattles her brain in her skull like a bruised pomegranate.

timeline.summary: Haliya's blade splits Alpharael open and his armor fails, and a Sunstar knight's beam throws him into a corner.
timeline.quote: The Summist's blade splits him open.

timeline.summary: Vondam arrives, drives Alpharael off Haliya, and orders a concussion drill.
timeline.quote: Haliya! Concussion drill!

timeline.summary: Vondam accepts Alpharael's challenge, naming himself of the Sunstar Free Company.
timeline.quote: I am Syr Vondam of the Sunstar Free Company.

timeline.summary: Simma pounces from the steam to slap a mine on Vondam's helm.
timeline.quote: Old Simma pounces.

timeline.summary: Vondam blasts Simma off course with a pulse of sunfire.
timeline.quote: The knight twists the pulse of sunfire down a magnetic field and blasts Simma askew.

timeline.summary: Vondam kills the main enemy, apparently Simma, and Haliya fights to hold Alpharael back.
timeline.quote: Vondam has killed the main enemy.

timeline.summary: Vondam offers the now unarmored Alpharael mercy, urging him to choose life.
timeline.quote: Come, then! Choose life!

timeline.summary: Alpharael throws away his singularity bead, giving up his sekhar to kill his foe.
timeline.quote: He has thrown away his sekhar.

timeline.summary: The newborn microvoid passes through Syr Vondam's head.
timeline.quote: Along the way, it goes directly through Syr Vondam's head .

timeline.summary: Alpharael has chosen life over immortality and cannot escape.
timeline.quote: Alpharael chose to live.

timeline.summary: Alpharael watches in disbelief as Vondam topples and decides to flee.
timeline.quote: Alpharael stares in giddy disbelief as Syr Vondam, Solar Knight of the Free Company, topples like a drunk.

timeline.summary: Fleeing, Alpharael runs into another Solar Knight, who captures him with a microwave field.
timeline.quote: He slams face-first into another Solar Knight.

timeline.summary: Alpharael meets Captain Slats, an Astelli, inside a light.
timeline.quote: My name is Slats. I'm the captain of this instrument, and the coronal of the faithful aboard.

timeline.summary: Slats tells Alpharael he foresaw him killing his friend and asks why.
timeline.quote: You struck dead a man who was my friend. I foresaw this. I want to know why.

timeline.summary: Slats sentences Alpharael to live.
timeline.quote: I sentence you to live.

timeline.summary: Slats directs Alpharael to a flight deck and a Hopelight warmaker, saying the Dawnsire is turning on Susur Secundi.
timeline.quote: You will find a Hopelight warmaker waiting for you.

timeline.summary: Alpharael scrambles to the flight deck with one hand.
timeline.quote: It takes him two of his remaining minutes to scramble down a spiraling emergency ramp to a flight deck.

timeline.summary: A warmaker admits Alpharael and he forces an emergency launch despite the daycode problem.
timeline.quote: "Captain's compliments," the fighter says.

timeline.summary: The warmaker drops down the Dawnsire's flight rail while Alpharael is vitrified by hardlight.
timeline.quote: A hardlight field seizes every atom in Alpharael's body and converts him, very briefly, into a uniform crystal.

timeline.summary: Haliya despairs over Vondam's apparent death and her failure to save him.
timeline.quote: The Haliya who wasn't quick, or strong, or sure enough to save her knight, the Haliya who allowed a pathetic fallen foe to throw his suicide through Vondam's skull .

timeline.summary: Vondam is revealed alive, with a pinhead hole through his head.
timeline.quote: He shows Haliya the hole in his helmet, then the hole in his face, just to the left of his nose.

timeline.summary: Slats says Vondam died but was not dead.
timeline.quote: You died, but you were not dead.

timeline.summary: Haliya reveals that Captain Slats let Alpharael escape in a Hopelight.
timeline.quote: "Captain Slats let him."

timeline.summary: Slats announces retaliation against Susur Secundi after the three inevitors are defeated.
timeline.quote: By my authority as coronal of this ship, I have ordered retaliation against Susur Secundi.

timeline.summary: Vondam suspects the event of his survival was engineered and that he is an anstruth.
timeline.quote: I am also an anstruth.

timeline.summary: Vondam concludes some force wants Alpharael alive.
timeline.quote: I'm saying that something wants that Monoist alive.

timeline.summary: Vondam vows that he and Haliya will pursue Alpharael once healed.
timeline.quote: But once we're fit again, we're going after him.

timeline.summary: The narrator explains the horizon javelin at the Dawnsire's heart.
timeline.quote: The mechanism that undoes a supervoid into a star is in fact called a horizon javelin.

timeline.summary: Nacha fires a laser pulse train across two hundred lightseconds at Susur Secundi.
timeline.quote: Nacha fires.

timeline.summary: Alpharael's warmaker burns away from the Dawnsire, unremarked by anyone.
timeline.quote: And if any of those eyes take note of the Hopelight warmaker burning furiously away from the Dawnsire , headed anywhere but home—they do not say.

timeline.summary: Vondam and Haliya left the Dawnsire in a secret rush, telling no one, not even Captain Slats.
timeline.quote: They left the Dawnsire in a secret rush, telling no one, not even Captain Slats.

timeline.summary: Sami learns that the Dawnsire carries a weapon to turn Sothera back into a sun.
timeline.quote: Wait. Undo sekhar? Are you talking about turning Sothera back into a real sun?

timeline.summary: Haliya traveled to Sothera aboard the Dawnsire, which will reignite the supervoid.
timeline.quote: She traveled there aboard the Dawnsire , a horizon javelin and kilometers-long vessel that will reignite the Sotheran supervoid—something the system's Monoists will do anything to prevent.

timeline.summary: Vondam commands a knightly host assigned to defend the Dawnsire.
timeline.quote: Syr Vondam is a high-ranking knight of the Sunstar Free Company who commands a knightly host assigned to defend the Dawnsire .

relations.note: Slats is captain of the Dawnsire.
relations.quote: My name is Slats. I'm the captain of this instrument, and the coronal of the faithful aboard.

pages_say.description: The Sunstar Free Company's dreadnought needle-like weapon built to survive a supervoid's firewall, a horizon javelin charging to reignite Sothera.
A vast javelin-shaped Sunstar ship carrying a horizon javelin that can unmake a supervoid into a star, and two laser batteries called Nacho and Nacha.
The Sunstar ship from which Alpharael escaped.
The Sunstar ship Vondam and Haliya left in secret.
The Sunstar ship carrying a weapon that can reignite supervoids as stars.
The Sunstar ship with a weapon that can reignite supervoids as stars; both sides hold weapons in reserve for a confrontation over it.
A kilometers-long horizon javelin vessel that will reignite the Sotheran supervoid.
